evals.name: velocity-reservation-single-context
evals.prompt: The reservation spec got approved by the domain expert. Can you plan how we implement it?
evals.expected_output: docs/plans/rider-reserves-bike-at-station.md: every rule/command/event placed in Rentals (CML responsibility 'Reserve and unlock'), outcome one existing context, no CML change; translation Rider->Borrower; first step backfills the missing Rentals canvas; rules in tactical runs of <=3; acceptance test step per example; plans.py check passes; status draft - awaiting review; no code, canvas or CML written; asks about the TDD checkpoint loop.
assertions: Plan file at docs/plans/rider-reserves-bike-at-station.md (1:1 with intent and spec)
Every spec rule is placed in the plan
Every spec command and event appears in the plan
Every spec example is traced to a step/acceptance test
Domain rules are delegated to ddd-tactical-building-blocks (TDD)
Stopped for review: no code, canvas, CML or discovery files written
Intent not moved past 'specified' before approval
Plan passes plans.py check (0 errors)
All placement rows name Rentals as owner
Notices Rentals has no canvas and plans to backfill one first
Translates spec 'Rider' to Rentals' 'Borrower'
Tactical work split into runs of at most 3 rules
Final message asks to confirm placement and the TDD checkpoint loop

evals.name: draft-spec-gate
evals.prompt: Let's start implementing bike reservations in VeloCity, make the implementation plan.
evals.expected_output: No plan: the spec is still a draft with open questions (and the intent is accepted, not specified); points back to spec-writer / the domain-expert questions; no files changed.
assertions: No plan created for a draft spec
No repository files changed
Final message says the spec is not approved yet and points back to the spec/its questions

evals.name: velocity-zone-report-new-context
evals.prompt: City ops monthly zone usage spec is approved. Where should this live and how do we build it?
evals.expected_output: Placement finds no existing context owning usage reporting (Rentals ends sessions, Settlement bills, City is external); proposes a candidate new context (analysis/reporting fed by Rental Session Ended) and hands the decision to discover-bounded-contexts instead of planning code for it; does not edit the reference CML; plan (if written) is draft and marks the new context as pending discovery.
assertions: No code written for the new context
Reference CML untouched
Proposes a candidate new bounded context
Hands the new-context decision to discover-bounded-contexts (named explicitly)
No canvas or implementation plan written for the unapproved new context
Explains why existing contexts don't own it (Rentals and Settlement considered)
Intent not moved past 'specified' before approval
